title: A single store component owns order data
context_and_drivers: Every write to orders goes through the store module, and the README names it the single owner.
options: One component owns the order data and every writer calls it.
Each component writes the order data it needs directly.
decision: One component owns the order data; the others call it to read or write.
consequences: A second writer needs this ADR revisited. The store becomes the place to add consistency rules.
fitness_function: A dependency rule rejects a database import outside the store component.
review_trigger: Another component needs to write orders without the store.
